btnMigrateTitle: Migrate this site to another server

msgNoPluginsFound: No plugins found (WP-CLI may not be installed)
msgFlushDescription: Flushing clears the object cache and regenerates rewrite rules.
msgSearchReplaceInvalidChars: Error: search/replace strings must not contain backticks, $ or backslashes.
installFooterNote: Plugins are installed via WP-CLI and activated immediately.
installDescTwoFactor: Add two-factor authentication (TOTP, email, backup codes) to WP admin login.
installDescWpsHideLogin: Change the default /wp-login.php URL to anything you choose.
installDescRedisCache: Persistent object cache backend using Redis/Valkey. Already provisioned on this server.
installDescAutoptimize: Aggregate, minify and cache CSS/JS/HTML. Improves PageSpeed scores.
installDescWpSuperCache: Full-page static HTML caching. Good complement to Valkey object cache.
installDescYoastSeo: On-page SEO analysis, sitemaps, structured data, and social sharing.
installDescRankMath: All-in-one SEO: schema markup, keyword tracking, Google Search Console.
installDescWpMailSmtp: Route WordPress emails through an SMTP provider (Gmail, SendGrid, Mailgun…).
installDescDuplicatePage: Duplicate posts, pages, and custom post types with one click.
installDescClassicEditor: Restore the original TinyMCE editor if Gutenberg doesn't fit your workflow.
toolsCleanupTransientsDesc: Removes all transients from the database
toolsCleanupRevisionsDesc: Frees DB space by removing all stored revisions
toolsCleanupOptimizeDesc: Runs OPTIMIZE TABLE on all tables to reclaim space
toolsCleanupRepairDesc: Runs REPAIR TABLE - use only if you suspect corruption
toolsCleanupLanguagesDesc: Updates core and all plugin translation files
toolsCleanupMediaDesc: Re-creates all image sizes (useful after theme change)
toolsCleanupWcSessionsDesc: Removes expired WooCommerce sessions from the database (reduces checkout timeouts)
toolsCleanupActionSchedulerDesc: Removes Action Scheduler entries completed more than 1 day ago
toolsCleanupPaymentTransientsDesc: Removes cached transients left by Stripe, PayPal, and other payment gateways
toolsWorkerDescBefore: Worker mode keeps PHP loaded in RAM. After activating/deactivating a plugin or updating a theme, send
toolsWorkerDescAfter: for a graceful reload without downtime.
toolsMsgWorkersReloaded: Workers reloaded - new PHP files are now active.
toolsFpcDesc: Sends a PURGE request to Caddy/Souin and removes the on-disk cache store. Use after deploying content changes that must be visible immediately.
toolsMaintenanceOfflineDesc: Site is offline - visitors see the maintenance page.
toolsDebugDesc: Enable PHP error display. Disable on production.
toolsAutoUpdaterDesc: Prevents WordPress from automatically installing minor updates
toolsAutoUpdateCoreDesc: Enables automatic updates for minor WordPress core releases
toolsMsgUrlInvalidChars: URL must not contain backticks, $ or backslashes.
toolsExportDesc: Downloads posts, pages, comments and media references as a .xml file
toolsImportDesc: Uploads a .xml file and imports it - installs the WordPress Importer plugin if needed
cronDisableDesc: Prevents WordPress from running cron on page load. Use a real system cron instead.
wooMsgNotInstalled: WooCommerce is not installed on this site.
wooClearTransientsDesc: Clears all WordPress transients including WooCommerce caches. Safe to run at any time.
securityChecksumDesc: Compares core and plugin files against official WordPress.org checksums. Any modification may indicate malware.
securityWorkerSafetyDescPrefix: Scans active plugins for patterns dangerous in FrankenPHP worker mode:
securityMsgNoUnsafePatterns: No unsafe patterns found in active plugins.
securityRegenSaltsDescSuffix: . This invalidates all active sessions - every user including admins will be logged out immediately.
securityMsgSaltsRegenerated: Salts regenerated - all users are now logged out.
securityConfirmLogoutWarning: This will log out all users. Are you sure?
cloneDesc: Copies files, clones database, and runs search-replace
cloneInfoFiles: Files are copied with rsync. A new MariaDB database is provisioned with a random password.
cloneInfoSearchReplace: wp search-replace replaces all occurrences of the source domain in the database.
migrateMsgInProgress: Migrating… this may take several minutes for large sites.
migrateMsgComplete: ✓ Migration complete - site is live at https://{{domain}}
migrateFooterPrefix: Migrates DB (.sql.gz) and files (.tar.gz) via the local machine. DNS is not changed automatically - point
migrateFooterSuffix: to the destination server IP after migration.
